name: Sword of the Realms
description: A Tyrite-forged, glass-like sword with swirling blues and greens, made for Halvar by Koll, which can separate the realms.

timeline.summary: With the Sword of the Realms, Tibalt cuts open a doorway to Starnheim and unleashes Koma on the Valkyries.
timeline.quote: he cut open a doorway to the home of the Valkyries, where the Cosmos Serpent could make up for lost time

timeline.summary: Tibalt leaves a trail with the sword through Immersturm so a planeswalker will follow.
timeline.quote: he was leaving a trail, dragging the tip through the black basalt surface of Immersturm

timeline.summary: Kaya lays the Sword of the Realms on the table, and they learn Koll finished it but died with the secret of wielding it.
timeline.quote: But he took the secrets of how to wield it to the grave.

timeline.summary: Kaya tosses the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, who says he can use it to separate the realms if given time.
timeline.quote: Kaya tossed him the sword, which turned end over end through the air

timeline.summary: Halvar's sword light sweeps over the rift and it closes, ending the flow of draugr.
timeline.quote: Slowly, like a healing wound, the rift began to shrink and close.

relations.note: Koll forged the sword before dying.
relations.quote: Koll must have finally finished the bloody thing

pages_say.description: A blade of Tyrite that opens paths between all realms of Kaldheim, which Tibalt takes from Koll.
A Tyrite-forged, glass-like sword with swirling blues and greens, made for Halvar by Koll, which can separate the realms.
